paite: Huchi in kongpi ah, suahlam kongpi ah ahon pi hi.
heading: Tempul Ah TOUPA Akik

paite: Ngai dih, Israel' Pathian thupina suahlam a kipan in ahong tung a; ahusa tui tampi ging bang ahi a, athupina in leitung atanvak hi.
Kilakna ka muh a alatdan, khopi hihse ding a hong pai leh Kebar lui gei a kilakna ka muh bangmah ahi a; huchi in bokkhup in ka pukta hi.
Suahlam nga kongpi ah tempul sung ah TOUPA thupina alut hi.
Kha in ahon domkang a, huang sungnungzaw ah ahon pilut a; huan, ngai in, TOUPA thupina in tempul aluahdim hi.
Huan mi khat ka kiang a adin lai in mi kuahiam tempul polam a kipan hon houpih in ka za a, ka kiang ah,

"Mihing tapa, hiai ka laltutphah omna mun, ka khepek ngakna, Israel suante lak a tangtawn a ka tenna ding mun ahi; ka min siangthou Israel inkote'n amau inn hiam, akumpipate uh hiam, ahukna uleh akumpipate uh luangvuina a zang in ahihthanghuai nawnta kei ding uh.

Akongpi uh ka kongpi chin mahmah a bawl in, akongpi biang uh ka kongpi biang zul a koih in amau leh keimah kikal ah baang kia omsak in athilhih kihhuaite un ka min siangthou ahihthanghuai uhi; huaiziak in ka hehna in amau ka hihmangta hi.
Tu a kipan in kizuaknate, akumpipa uh luangte kei a kipan gamlapi ah koihmang le uh; huchi in alak uah tangtawn in ka teng ding hi.
"Nang mihing tapa, Israel inkote kiang ah tempul lim ensak in; athilhihkhelh uh azumpih theihna ding un, abawldan ding leng na teh uhen.

Huan athilhih tengteng uh azumpih ua atempul omdante, apawtkhiaknate, alutnate, ageldante, azatdante, akepdante ensak inla, amitmuh mahmah uah gelh in; adan pumpi leh azatdan tengteng avom ua, azuihtheihna ding un.
Hiai tempul a dia dan ding ahi; tang vum tau kim tengteng mun siangthoupen ding ahi; ngai dih, hiai tempul a dia dan ding ahi.
"Huan tong a teh in hiai maitam let lam ahi, tong khat chih tong khat leh khutpek tuam ahi a, akingakna tong khat a sang, tong khat a za, agei akim a khap khat a pawng zel ahi.
heading: Maitam

paite: Huan maitam sanlam hichibang ahi; lei a akingakna a kipan dohdan nuainungzaw pen tong nih ahi a, azatlam tong khat; adohdan neuzaw pen a kipan dohdan lianzaw pen tong li ahi a, tong khat a za ahi.
Amaitam tau tong li a sang ahi nawn a, maitam tau a kipan leh atunglam kii li ding ahi.
Maitam tau adung leh avai tong sawm-le-nih tuaktuak ahi; adung-avai kikim ahi.
Dohdan dung leh vai tong sawm-le-li tuaktuak ahi; adung-avai kikim ahi; agei tong kimkhat ahi; akingakna akim in tong khat ahi; akalbi in suahlam angat ding ahi," achi hi.
Huan ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, TOUPA Pathian in hichi in achi: Abawl khit chiang ua maitam zatdan ding hichibang ahi; halmang kithoihna dingte, sisan thehna dingte ahi.
heading: Maitam Latna

paite: Levi chi siampu Zadok suan a mi, nna hon sepsak ding a hon naih sekpa kiang ah khelh ziak a kithoihna ding in ganhon a pan bawngtaltuai na piak ding ahi, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Asisan na la ding a, maitam kii lite leh adohdan ning lite, agei kimvel in na luan ding a; huchibang in maitam na hihsiang in na siangsak ding hi.
Khelh ziak a kithoihna bawngtaltuai na la ding a, huai ding a tempul aseh uh, mun siangthou polam ah hal ahih ding ahi.
Huan ani nihna in keltal dembei, khelh ziak a kithoihna ding a lat ding ahi; huchi in maitam bel bawngtaltuai a ahihsiang mah bang un na siangsak ding hi.
Maitam hihsiang pen na hih khit chiang un ganhon a pan bawngtaltuai gensiatbei leh belamtal, gensiatbei, ahon lak a na lan ding hi.
TOUPA ma ah na lan ding a, siampu in chi asoh ding a, TOUPA kiang ah halmang a ding in alan ding.
Ni sagih sung niteng khelh ziak a kithoihna ding in keltal na zang ding ahi; ganhon a pan bawngtaltuai leh belamtal, ahon lak a, gensiatbei leng azat ding uh ahi.
Maitam hihsiang leh siansakna in ni sagih ala ding a; huchi in maitam siangthou ahita ding hi.

Huan huai nite ahihtangtun khit chiang un, ani giat ni a kipan in siampute'n na halmang kithoihnate uh leh lemna kithoihnate amaitam uah alan ding ua, huan ka hon na sang ding chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi," achi hi.
